messages.content: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

message.content:
I can help identify a suitable **photography course at a community center**, but I can’t complete the sign-up from here because I don’t have access to your personal account or the center’s registration system.

If you want to enroll, these community-center options are available from the search results:

- **Phoenix Center for the Arts** offers photography classes for beginner and advanced students, including **Beginning Digital Photography** and **Street Photography**.[1]
- **City of Walnut Creek / Center for Community Arts** offers **Digital Media & Photography** classes at its Shadelands location.[2]
- **Frederick Community College** offers photography classes for beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels.[7]

For the Phoenix Center class page, the listed registration rule says **registration ends 2 days prior to the first class**, and students or guardians must bring ID to the first class.[1]

If you want, I can help you narrow this down by:
- your city or neighborhood
- your skill level
- whether you want digital, darkroom, or beginner-only classes
- your preferred date and budget
